name: Spirit of Life is friendly to opposite-faction group members (#7692)
contract: Issue #7692 (class 31 Primalist): Spirits of Life summoned by Primordial Earth were red to, and could be attacked by, opposite-faction players in the summoner's raid. spell_ascension_primordial_spirit (AscensionPrimalistLifeSpirit.cpp) handles Spirits of Life 572853 by summoning creature 840002 with the owner's faction and owner GUID. Unit::GetReactionTo only applies its same-group REP_FRIENDLY rule when both units carry UNIT_FLAG_PLAYER_CONTROLLED; the spirit lacked the flag, so an Alliance group member fell through to the raw Horde faction check and IsValidAttackTarget allowed the attack. The spirit is now player-controlled like the other CoA class summons. An Orc Primalist is grouped with a PvP-enabled Human warrior, who must not be able to attack the spirit. A hostile monster fixture (faction 14) is the control: it must still be able to attack the spirit, so the observation is not trivially zero.

steps.label: SETUP: Spirits of Life summons a Spirit of Life
CONTRACT: the opposite-faction group member cannot attack the spirit
CONTROL: a hostile monster can still attack the spirit
